patches_added.name: Disable ads
patches_added.description: Disables CHZZK advertisements, including live stream pre-roll, mid-roll and post-roll ads and clip feed ads.

patches_added.name: Hide home banners
patches_added.description: Hides promotional banners on the CHZZK home recommend tab, including the top banner carousel and the in-feed event and image banners.

patches_added.name: Unlock cheat key
patches_added.description: Unlocks CHZZK cheat key subscription benefits without an active subscription.

patches_added.name: Remove Catch ads
patches_added.description: Removes the ads inserted between clips in the Catch feed by reporting no ad slots.

patches_added.name: Remove VOD ads
patches_added.description: Removes VOD pre-roll ads by reporting every stream as QuickView Plus to the player's own ad-skip check.

patches_added.name: Remove banner ads
patches_added.description: Removes the VOD companion and search banner ads.

patches_added.name: Remove exit dialog ad
patches_added.description: Removes the ad area shown in the app-exit confirmation dialog, keeping the dialog itself.

patches_added.name: Remove intro ads
patches_added.description: Removes the image, video and cinema intro ad banners shown on launch.

patches_added.name: Remove list banner ads
patches_added.description: Removes the native banner ads under the live player and in feeds by stopping their ad request, so no banner is fetched or shown.

patches_added.name: Remove live ads
patches_added.description: Removes the live pre-roll ad by routing every ad decision into the app's own no-video path so the stream starts immediately.

patches_added.name: Remove live banner ads
patches_added.description: Removes the banner ads shown under the live player by stopping their driver from attaching the banner fragments.

patches_added.name: Remove main board ads
patches_added.description: Removes the native "main board" banner ad shown in feeds and under the live player.
